run: an MHW_NODE that is not executable
stderr: REFUSE  MHW_NODE (<T>/no-such-node) is not an executable file; nothing staged or installed

run: an admin root holding a quote
stderr: REFUSE  <QUOTED>/<BASE>/bin holds a quote, backslash, dollar sign or backtick

run: uninstall prints the line for the real root
stdout:
RUN     sudo /bin/sh "<T>/tree/global/install-managed.sh" --remove
THEN    ./mhw install   (restores the user-level hooks), then open fresh sessions
